## 4. MOSFET single-pulse stress (6x IRLZ44N, worst-shared device)

Zth(t) = RthJC*sqrt(t/tau) capped at RthJC (assumption). Current held constant (conservative).

| Total current A | Case | T_case C | I per device A | IDM margin | Tj after 20 ms | Tj after 50 ms | Tj after 100 ms | Max pulse for Tj<=150 C |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 200 | best | 35 | 37 | 4.4x | 48 C | 56 C | 67 C | 1000 ms |
| 200 | typ | 50 | 40 | 4.0x | 71 C | 85 C | 104 C | 244 ms |
| 200 | worst | 65 | 43 | 3.7x | 102 C | 132 C | 178 C | 70 ms |
| 294 | best | 35 | 54 | 3.0x | 65 C | 87 C | 116 C | 165 ms |
| 294 | typ | 50 | 59 | 2.7x | 101 C | 146 C | 222 C | 53 ms |
| 294 | worst | 65 | 64 | 2.5x | 171 C | 326 C | runaway | 15 ms |
| 388 | best | 35 | 71 | 2.2x | 94 C | 144 C | 226 C | 54 ms |
| 388 | typ | 50 | 78 | 2.1x | 163 C | 320 C | runaway | 17 ms |
| 388 | worst | 65 | 84 | 1.9x | runaway | runaway | runaway | 5 ms |
| 450 | best | 35 | 82 | 1.9x | 121 C | 209 C | 393 C | 30 ms |
| 450 | typ | 50 | 90 | 1.8x | 239 C | runaway | runaway | 10 ms |
| 450 | worst | 65 | 98 | 1.6x | runaway | runaway | runaway | 3 ms |

Conclusion basis: the firmware ON-time limit must stay below the 'typ' max-pulse column at the expected current.


## 5. Average dissipation (repetition)

- One weld every 2 s, 65 ms total ON: 8.5 J/device/weld -> 4.3 W/device, 26 W total into the drain busbar/heatsink.
- One weld every 5 s, 65 ms total ON: 8.5 J/device/weld -> 1.7 W/device, 10 W total into the drain busbar/heatsink.
- One weld every 10 s, 65 ms total ON: 8.5 J/device/weld -> 0.9 W/device, 5 W total into the drain busbar/heatsink.

## 6. Inductive energy at turn-off

- I = 294 A: welding-cable energy 65 mJ (free-wheels through STPS3045CP), battery-lead energy 17 mJ (absorbed by 1000 uF + SMBJ24CA at the assembly bus).
- I = 388 A: welding-cable energy 113 mJ (free-wheels through STPS3045CP), battery-lead energy 30 mJ (absorbed by 1000 uF + SMBJ24CA at the assembly bus).
- Free-wheel time constant ~0.40 ms; I2t per diode die (2 dice share) ~7.6 A2s vs. 242 A2s for 220 A/10 ms half-sine (DS3 IFSM).

## 7. Control rail hold-up (diode-isolated banks)

Worst-case bank voltage before the pulse: 11.19 V (OCV min - Vf max - I*R_tap).

| Rail | C used uF (min) | Load A (max) | ON time ms | Droop V | End voltage V | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Logic + gate drive | 7200 | 0.11 | 65 | 0.99 | 10.20 | UVLO 8.2 V, 7805 7.0 V |
| Relay coil | 11760 | 0.33 | 65 | 1.82 | 9.37 | relay drop-out voltage UNKNOWN |
| Logic + gate drive | 7200 | 0.11 | 96 | 1.47 | 9.72 | UVLO 8.2 V, 7805 7.0 V |
| Relay coil | 11760 | 0.33 | 96 | 2.69 | 8.50 | relay drop-out voltage UNKNOWN |

(65 ms = firmware maximum ON time: 50 ms main + 15 ms pre-pulse; second row = upper bound of the hardware limiter per ON interval.)

Inrush at connection: peak 8.6 A, energy in R_tap 2.37 J, I2t 1.58 A2s (choose a T3.15 A fuse with I2t >> this value).


## 8. Hardware pulse-length limiter window (Monte-Carlo, 20 000 samples)

R = 68 kOhm 1 %, C = 1 uF (-20/+10 %), Vth = VCC x 22k/(10k+22k), VCC 4.8-5.2 V, VOH VCC-0..0.2 V, LM393 Vos 5 mV.

- Hardware limit: min **63 ms**, median 78 ms, max **96 ms**.
- Firmware limit per ON interval: 50 ms -> margin to HW minimum 13 ms.

## 9. ADC scaling

- VBAT / VELEC / VDRV / VHOLD / VDRAIN: divider 33k/10k, k = 4.30; full scale 21.5 V at AVCC=5 V (21.0 mV/LSB), 4.73 V with the 1.1 V internal reference (4.6 mV/LSB); source impedance 7.7 kOhm.
- V_DS at typical current: 1723 mV -> current estimate from V_DS has +-30 % uncertainty (RDS(T) spread). It is an indication, not a measurement.

## 10. Cable adiabatic short-circuit withstand

- 10 mm2: I2t = 1.32 MA2s -> 9 s at 388 A
- 16 mm2: I2t = 3.39 MA2s -> 22 s at 388 A
- 25 mm2: I2t = 8.27 MA2s -> 55 s at 388 A

Weld-pulse I2t through the main fuse (best case 388 A, 65 ms): 9.8 kA2s per weld -> compare with the fuse's PRE-ARCING I2t (datasheet); require pre-arc I2t >= 5x pulse I2t to avoid fatigue.
